धे धे, cl. 1. P. धयति, दधौ, धास्-
यति, अधात्, अधासीत्, अदधत्, Prec. धे-
यात्, धातुम्, to suck, drink, to suck in, drink in,
absorb; appropriate; to suck out, draw away, take
away: Caus. धापयति, -यितुम्, to give suck,
suckle, nourish: Desid. धित्सति, to wish to suck;
[cf. दधि, धात्री, 2. धायस्, धारु, 2. धासि:
Zend daēnu, ‘female:’ Gr. θῆ-σθαι, θη-λή, θη-λώ,
θηλα-μών, τήθη, τι-θή-νη, τί-τθο-ς, θῆ-λυ-ς,
γαλα-θη-νό-ς, Τη-θύ-ς, ϴέ-τι-ς: Lat. fī-liu-s, fī-
li-a, fē-lā-re, fē-mina: Umbr. fe-liu = filius:
Goth. dadd-ya = Old Germ. tā-u, ‘I suck;’ tila,
‘female breast;’ tuta, tutta = Eng. teat: Slav. do-
ya, ‘to suck;’ doilica, ‘nurse;’ de†-te, ‘child;’
de†-va, ‘virgin:’ Hib. daif, ‘drink.’]
